name: The Outpost
highConcept: An industrial settlement built around the remains of impossible floating ruins.
trouble: Every new Gate destabilizes the harbor and the old ruin answers back.
aspects: Shared frontier of lore and danger

capabilities.name: Industry
capabilities.summary: Crafting, repairs and manufacturing for the settlement and expeditions.
capabilities.detail: Industry represents the Outpost's ability to build and maintain tools, equipment, structures, and practical systems in the face of unusual demands.
capabilities.use: Expeditioners can request repairs, custom tools, salvaged fabrication, and infrastructure support.
capabilities.assets: Foundry yards, repair sheds, workshops, salvage crews.
capabilities.conditions: Current operating pressure is visible in the strained harbor and damaged support structures.

capabilities.name: Research
capabilities.summary: Gate investigation, artifact analysis, and anomalous research.
capabilities.detail: Research covers the Outpost's capacity to understand Gates, test artifacts, interpret environmental anomalies, and connect observations into a broader map of the campaign world.
capabilities.use: Players can use Research to interpret discoveries, map new locations, and understand the consequences of alien materials.
capabilities.assets: Observation decks, laboratory spaces, field archives, specialist analysts.
capabilities.conditions: Newly recovered artifacts and partial survey data continue to expand the public record.

capabilities.name: Commerce
capabilities.summary: Trade, funding, and resource conversion for expeditions and settlement needs.
capabilities.detail: Commerce represents the Outpost's access to trade, financing, supply chains, and market pressure.
capabilities.use: Expeditioners can secure material purchases, funding, route planning, and exchange for recovered resources.
capabilities.assets: Harbor contracts, trader stores, salvage brokers, shipping lanes.
capabilities.conditions: Commercial activity remains active but sensitive to the volatility of new discoveries.

capabilities.name: Security
capabilities.summary: Defense, policing, and emergency response around the Gate network and settlement.
capabilities.detail: Security covers the practical response to threats, containment issues, and the enforcement of order around dangerous environments.
capabilities.use: Expeditioners may rely on crews, patrols, response teams, and protective infrastructure during active incidents.
capabilities.assets: Harbor patrols, locked facilities, barricaded routes, emergency teams.
capabilities.conditions: Current threats remain real but are being contained as the public record updates.

capabilities.name: Medicine
capabilities.summary: Treatment, stabilization, and recovery after dangerous expeditions.
capabilities.detail: Medicine is responsible for triage, recovery, rehabilitation, and the treatment of injuries or exposure tied to Gates and the anomalous world beyond them.
capabilities.use: Expeditioners can seek treatment after exposure, trauma, and field injury. Medical care is a major source of resilience and recovery.
capabilities.assets: Aid stations, staffed infirmaries, case records, specialized treatments.
capabilities.conditions: Long-term recovery remains a concern as more unusual injuries are identified.

capabilities.name: Infrastructure
capabilities.summary: Facilities, transportation, and services that keep the Outpost functional.
capabilities.detail: Infrastructure keeps the settlement coherent: transit, power, utilities, facilities, and route stability.
capabilities.use: Expeditioners rely on road and harbor routes, access to facilities, and the practical services that support expedition operations.
capabilities.assets: Dockworks, transit corridors, utility networks, critical buildings.
capabilities.conditions: Damage to support systems makes this capability more valuable and more fragile.

consequences.name: Damaged Dockworks
consequences.detail: Harbor access and supply throughput are impaired after repeated shocks and gate activity.

consequences.name: Fissure Risk in the Old Ruin
consequences.detail: Accessible sectors remain stable, but deeper ruin areas carry unpredictable structural stress.

facilities.name: Harbor Ledger Hall
facilities.summary: A central station for cargo manifests, route planning, and expedition intake.

facilities.name: Survey Spire
facilities.summary: A high-priority research and observation site for Gate behavior and environmental scan data.

facilities.name: Field Infirmary
facilities.summary: Medical response and stabilization point for expeditions returning from dangerous routes.

activeProjects.name: Harbor Reinforcement
activeProjects.summary: Repair and resecure the deep dock structures after repeated disruption.

activeProjects.name: Gate Mapping Sweep
activeProjects.summary: Update survey data around newly recorded Gate activity and improve route safety.

activeProjects.name: Ruin Stabilization
activeProjects.summary: Assess structural risk in ancient sectors and plan strategic access improvements.

conditions.name: Unstable Harbor Approach
conditions.summary: Travel and cargo access are more dangerous during active Gate events.

conditions.name: Public Research Expansion
conditions.summary: The Outpost has more data than before, but not all conclusions are yet verified.
